messages:
Priya R.: Heads-up — customer asked for an ad-hoc filter bar in the route inspector so they can quickly drill into failure spikes by model+route+tag. Not asking savedviews initially, just a fast typed filter.
Jordan L.: +1. Are we talking free-form expr (eg `model:v2 AND latency>300`) or UI chips?
Priya R.: Free-form for power users, chips for regular folks. UX needs to map to the same internal query object.
Alex C.: Implementation note: our telemetry API expects a query object like `{"scope":{...},"filters":[]}`. If we accept free-form, we need a parser that turns text -> filters. Could reuse the query parser from the insights service.
Emily P.: Concern: if we let free-form be saved implicitly, we might leak route-level quotas or be unclear about sampling. Proposal: ad-hoc = ephemeral, explicit "Save as query" CTA to persist.
Jordan L.: Agreed on ephemeral default. Also: telemetry sampling matters. If a user filters to a low-traffic route and runs top-k, the numbers will be noisy. Add a small inline warning and a data-sampling badge ("approximate — sampled at 1%")
Priya R.: Good call. UX should show sampling and which data window is used. Also want a quick toggle to run query against full-resolution logs (slow, costy) vs compiled telemetry (fast).
Alex C.: Backend tradeoff: full-res hits the logs cluster and increases cost. We can add a `resolution` flag to the API: `telemetry.v1/query?resolution=high|low`. Default low uses aggregated rollups.
Emily P.: Routing policy angle: if a saved query pins a model variant, we should surface a note: "This view may exclude fallback routes". Users were confused last week.
Jordan L.: Implementation detail: saved queries should record `route_selector` AND `model_variant_list` to be deterministic on replay.
Priya R.: UX microflow: user types filter -> runs -> sees data -> small toast "Save this view" with scope options (Personal / Team / Org) -> saving persists query + selector. Ephemeral queries expire after 48h unless saved. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Alex C.: 48h expiry ok. We should also rate-limit ephemeral query runs per user to avoid overload (esp high-res). backend throttle exists but call it out in UX.
Emily P.: From permissions side, team/org scope needs ACLs. Product analytics team should own ability to share org-wide.
telemetry-bot: Note: recent deploy includes `telemetry:v1` query param for `resolution` and `include_model_variants=true`. Docs PR at http://go/doc/telemetry-query (draft).
Priya R.: Next steps: Jordan/Alex to prototype API contract for ad-hoc -> parsed filters by EOD Friday. Emily to draft UX copy and permissions flow. I'll sync with sales for a couple customer edge-cases.
Jordan L.: I'll toss a tiny parser POC (python) into the insights repo and post link.
Alex C.: Will add `resolution` and `include_model_variants` to the internal API RFC and surface cost estimates in the console when high-res is selected.
Emily P.: Sounds good. Priya — can you create a quick ticket with ACs? I can attach permission matrix. :+1:
Priya R.: On it. Thanks everyone.
